body:
Tier 5 in scripts/rl_env_packet.py: a per-tick bonus that grows along the real Fibonacci sequence (1,1,2,3,5,...) the longer a life lasts (capped at fib-index 20), scaled exponentially by current damage percent (2.0**(damage/100), doubles every 100 damage), reset to zero the instant a stock is actually lost. Founder real-time: 'add a reward that ticks up over time so fib like 1 1 2 3 5 reward for not die also it should go exponentially ish for the higher damage you are it should reward you even more when you oof it resets.' 5 new tests, 99/99 total pass.

⚓ ☃
title: S423: Fibonacci survival-streak reward tier
